set.body: Goal: perform one evidence-backed current-state grade after the active graphics roadmap decisions are complete. Scope includes the original target-10 work and the scalar-field family through filled contour bands. Before grading: extraction-readiness guard and publication plan complete; platform metrics delivered or closed with an explicit opt-in deferral policy; the canonical aesthetic model and heterogeneous-layer policy complete; solver-owned guide stacking complete; Geom.Line semantics documented; no declared enum member is runtime-rejected; all four backend conformance suites and the visual gallery are signed off; full testAll is green on JVM and Scala.js. Deliverable: record the score, commands, counts, visual evidence, and explicit waivers in an issue note; file concrete follow-ons for any remaining gap; reconcile and close or supersede overlapping graphics roadmap epics. No implementation belongs in this gate.
set.title: Graphics: current-state re-grade and tracker reconciliation gate
